Trivy scan, gitleaks) -> squash merge to main
  -> image pushed to northbridgeacr.azurecr.io
  -> helm upgrade to northbridge-dev (AKS dev)

git tag v1.4.0 -> auto-deploy to northbridge-staging
  -> manual approval gate (GitHub Environments)
  -> helm upgrade to northbridge-prod (AKS prod)
  -> shop.northbridgeretail.com
